outcome: Laboratory findings (C-reactive protein, lymphopenia, white blood cells, liver enzymes)
cohort: 81 pregnant women with COVID-19 admitted to healthcare centers in Yazd, Iran between March 2020 and September 2020.
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 experienced common COVID-19 symptoms and some had pregnancy complications, including preterm delivery; a small number of neonates tested positive for COVID-19, suggesting possible vertical transmission.
